items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Jay, he came to Kansas City, too.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. I'd just finished high school. And so I said I would like to come there to go to school, so I went to junior college in Kansas City, Kansas.
Oh. Well, that's what Jay McShann, Jay MacSham, didn't he?
Yeah, Jay, he came to Kansas City, too.
